top_signals.title: Bulgaria Calls Off Search for Crew After Black Sea Drone Strike Sinks Ship
top_signals.summary: Bulgaria has halted its search for the missing crew of a ship that sank after being hit by a drone on Tuesday about 70 nautical miles (130 km) off its coast, Vice-Admiral Rumen Nikolov of the Maritime Administration Executive Agency told Nova TV on Wednesday.Early on Tuesday…
